en.headline: 325 own commits across 9 repos, 3 skill-tool releases and 6 issue actions on
en.teaser: A month of OpenCode skill tooling: skill-management reached 1.2.0, go-model-picker shipped 2.0.0 through 3.0.1, and pixel-logo-toolkit tagged its first two releases.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-22 to 2026-11-20 with data for every day. Across all repositories the totals were 325 own commits, 1 pull request, 9 issue actions and 0 reviews; a further 627 automated commits were recorded, all of them in the profile repository.

### OpenCode skill tooling

Most of the work went into three OpenCode skills. `opencode-skill-management` was documented and released three times: v1.0.0 froze the list/inspect/disable/enable surface, v1.1.0 switched all four actions to a single JSON object with a declared output schema, and v1.2.0 fixed the diverged-agent count and frontmatter boolean normalization. The same repo also gained an Astro + Starlight bilingual docs site deployed through GitHub Actions, plus landing-page and mobile fixes.

`opencode-go-model-picker` moved from priced accounting and Console calibration in 2.0.0 to a much smaller 3.0.0 layout, then 3.0.1 enforced the candidate model menu, per-source chains and a comparing `check`. Later commits added the format-side self-check list, documented where each money source may print, and stopped the calibrate step from restamping an old bias with today's date.

`opencode-agent-sandbox` was the busiest repository by commit count, almost entirely knowledge-base documentation: the OMO slim skill table, the openchamber-storage category, VS Code harness notes, and SenseNova image-skill notes with a Windows-without-WSL2 correction. One pull request was opened there.

### Translation, pixel art and reports

`sopen-translate` built an MV3 extension skeleton, then added a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress, and dropped selection translation in favour of page translation only. It also gained JSDoc `checkJs` type checking and DOM smoke tests.

`pixel-logo-toolkit` shipped v0.2.0 and v0.3.0: automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, an English-first README with a Chinese version, a 40-image command gallery, and a Korean font fix because Ark Pixel's ko build lacks Hangul. `dsh-ecosystem-report` got a single-button theme menu, mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414, visual refinements and three merged plugin entries. `dsh-openchamber-plugins` added a hidden-files toggle, an `/init` skill and a zh-doc-sync skill, and archived ported skills. `myBlog` received two documentation commits with screenshots.

### Upstream reports

Outside the user's own repositories, six issue actions went to `openchamber/openchamber`, covering storage management, the missing Console MCP server in settings, the stale session-retention hint, the quote-card arrow no-op and unreliable drag-to-comment in the files view. One issue was opened against `microsoft/PowerToys` about a NullReferenceException in Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation, and one action went to `anomalyco/opencode` on the Windows desktop CLI request.

v1.1.0 made all four actions return one JSON object validated against a declared output schema.

v0.3.0 added automatic line wrapping and proportional font-size fallback with a 9px floor.
Opened pull request #1 in the sandbox knowledge repository.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Opened an issue about Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation throwing NullReferenceException.
Commented on the AI narrative generation failure tracking issue.

zh.headline: 9 个仓库共 325 次本人提交，技能工具发布 3 次，OpenChamber 上 6 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 这个月主要在做 OpenCode 技能工具：skill-management 发到 1.2.0，go-model-picker 从 2.0.0 走到 3.0.1，pixel-logo-toolkit 打出前两个版本。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-22 至 2026-11-20，30 天均有数据。全部仓库合计 325 次本人提交、1 个拉取请求、9 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论）、0 次评审；另有 627 次自动提交，全部集中在个人主页仓库。

### OpenCode 技能工具

大部分工作落在三个 OpenCode 技能上。`opencode-skill-management` 连发三版：v1.0.0 冻结 list/inspect/disable/enable 四个动作的接口，v1.1.0 把四个动作统一改为返回单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema，v1.2.0 修正了跨 agent 差异计数和 frontmatter 布尔值归一化。该仓库还新增了 Astro + Starlight 双语文档站，由 GitHub Actions 构建部署，并修了落地页与移动端问题。

`opencode-go-model-picker` 先以 2.0.0 引入计价核算与 Console 校准，3.0.0 把技能压缩成一个入口和一个参考文档，3.0.1 强制候选模型菜单、按来源决定链长，并让 `check` 重新推导数字。后续提交补了格式侧自检清单、各金额来源的打印规则，并让校准不再用当天日期覆盖旧偏差。

`opencode-agent-sandbox` 按提交数是最活跃的仓库，内容几乎全是知识库文档：OMO slim 技能全表、openchamber-storage 类别、VS Code harness 笔记，以及 SenseNova 图像技能速查和 Windows 不必上 WSL2 的实测纠正。该仓库开出了 1 个拉取请求。

### 翻译、像素图与报告

`sopen-translate` 先搭出 MV3 扩展骨架，随后加入 provider 协议层（预设、模型列表、术语表流水线）、双语页面渲染与分块、熔断和进度，并删掉划词翻译只保留整页翻译。此外补了 JSDoc `checkJs` 类型检查和 DOM 冒烟测试。

`pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0：自动折行与溢出保护、中英双语命令行、英文默认加中文版的 README、40 张命令示例画廊，并因 Ark Pixel 的 ko 版不含谚文而改用 Galmuri 字体。`dsh-ecosystem-report` 做了单按钮主题菜单、375 与 414 视口适配、视觉精修，并并入 3 个插件条目。`dsh-openchamber-plugins` 新增隐藏文件开关、`/init` 技能和 zh-doc-sync 技能，并归档了移植技能。`myBlog` 有 2 次文档提交，附截图。

### 上游反馈

在本人仓库之外，`openchamber/openchamber` 上有 6 次 issue 互动，涉及临时文件存储管理、设置页缺少 Console MCP 服务器、过时的会话保留提示、引用卡片箭头无响应，以及文件视图拖选行号评论不可靠。`microsoft/PowerToys` 新开一个 issue，报告 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活时抛 NullReferenceException；`anomalyco/opencode` 上有 1 次互动，针对 Windows 桌面版自带 CLI 却无法运行的请求。

highlights.text: v1.0.0 为 1.x 系列冻结了 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作的接口。
v1.1.0 让四个动作统一返回单个 JSON 对象，并由声明的输出 schema 校验。
3.0.0 把模型需读的文本从 104,181 字符压到 8,291 字符，运行入口从 9 个减到 1 个。
v0.3.0 加入自动折行，以及字号按比例下调、下限 9px 的溢出保护。
在沙箱知识库仓库开出拉取请求 #1。
新开缺陷报告：设置页的 MCP 列表漏掉了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
新开 issue，报告 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活时抛 NullReferenceException。
在 AI 叙述生成失败的跟踪 issue 下留言。
